story_title.value: Smart home devices should work without the internet

comment_text.value: Yes, if I wanted to put more work into it I could certainly train it on what it looks like with the sump mostly dry (the default state, 99.999% of the time) and then have it alert me if it diverges from that. Right now I keep an eye on weather alerts for $home and glance at the cameras at least once a day when I'm away, which is good enough to catch a failed sump pump and then dispatch professional repair services.
